ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The circuit diagram shows R1 and R2 connected between the same top and bottom nodes, so they are parallel branches. The total current I enters the top node from the left and splits into branch current I1 downward through R1 and branch current I2 downward through R2. Reasoning: For parallel branches, the total current is I = I1 + I2. Given I = 3 A and I1 = 2 A, I2 = 3 - 2 = 1 A. The voltage across R1 is V = I1 R1 = 2 A × 100 Ω = 200 V. Since R1 and R2 are in parallel, R2 has the same voltage, 200 V. Therefore R2 = V / I2 = 200 V / 1 A = 200 Ω.
